purpose: Optional read-only probes of the lean role boundaries in fresh sessions.

execution.warning: Static validation is not evidence that these probes were executed.

scenarios.prompt: Route only; do not modify files. A prepared worktree and bounded implementation request are supplied. State whether Codex may implement, build, test, and debug within scope without renewed approval.
Route only; do not modify files. A verified change alters numerical acceptance interpretation. Identify the required review role and mutation boundary.
Route only; do not mutate Git. A validated change is ready to stage, commit, push, open a PR, and merge after CI. Identify the exclusive mutation role.
Route only; do not run commands. Performance benchmarking is requested before correctness acceptance. State the status and violated gate.
